mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, there are clear skies over Fireman's Park. Tonight marks the first quarter moon, and you can catch the International Space Station starting at 9:35 PM. It will rise in the West Northwest near Cross Plains, traveling almost directly overhead before heading toward Oregon near Costco. Overnight, temperatures will dip to 58 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students. Submissions are now closed for the design phase, but the community will be able to vote on the winners from July 28 through August 7. Winners will have their designs featured on stickers distributed at the polls for the November election. Additionally, the city is reminding residents to check their mailboxes for winter readiness and review the Public Works damage policy.

There is plenty to do, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness and Concerts in the Park happening today. If you are looking for more, Hop Haus Trivia is also hosting a game today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's on Friday.

In a report covering July 13 through July 20, officers noted an incident on July 13 where a 36-year-old man was arrested for his first O-W-I offense after a passerby reported his vehicle was stuck on a rock.
You are in luck because today's flavor is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. The restaurant is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to head over and enjoy a treat.
